Author: gitignore
Description: This mod changes Vietnamese civ to have Mangudai as unique unit, and adds some bonuses to Cavalry Archer, the tech tree almost stays the same.CIVILIZATION BONUSES* Economic technologies cost no wood and are researched 100% faster.* Archery Range units and Fire Lancers have +20% hit points.* Reveal enemy initial Town Centers location at the start of the game.* Conscription is free.* Cavalry Archers fire 25% faster. (Mongols)* Parthian Tactics is free. (Tatars, partial)* Castles cost 15% less. (Franks, partial)TEAM BONUS* Imperial Skirmisher upgrade is available in the Imperial Age.UNIQUE UNIT* Mangudai. (Mongols)UNIQUE TECH CASTLE AGE* Silk Armor: scouts and mounted archers have +1/+1 armor. (Tatars)UNIQUE TECH IMPERIAL AGE* Recurve Bow: Mounted Archers gain +1 range and +1 attack. (Magyars)CREDIT: The custom civ maker websites by Krakenmeister and Andesia were a great starting point, but due to some issues with combining vanilla civs and new civs,I used Advanced Genie Editor in AoE2DE Tools_Builds to directly modify the data file.
Title: VNMangudai
